assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current rate-control management.
The CPT code for the mobile cardiac telemetry is 93229.
The diagnosis codes are I25.10 and I34.0.
This procedure directly supports medical necessity for monitoring the suspected arrhythmia.
The payer letter acknowledged that this decision does not preclude future coverage if proper authorization is secured.
